Use case: scientific-educational. Create one first-grade science picture-quiz atlas, exact equal invisible 3×3 grid on a truly transparent alpha background, nine distinct assets in the exact row-major positions. Keep each asset centered with fully transparent padding on all sides, especially between neighboring cells. No visible grid, boxes, letters, numbers, ruler ticks, logos, labels, decorative specks in the empty space, checkmarks or answer cues. Approved illustration style: delicate fine paper grain, matte gouache and clean cut-paper silhouettes, warm cream and pine green with restrained apricot tones, enough material detail to distinguish shapes at the small screen. Use honest colors and bold material texture.
Row 1 column 1: one sage-green knit glove at a slight diagonal, five clear fingers and a visible ribbed cuff, broad wool stitch pattern, soft textile. Nothing else.
Row 1 column 2: one short uncoated brown paperboard tube with an entirely intact rim, angled to see the thin rolled paperboard layers and hollow center; no label, end caps, crushed end, or contents.
Row 1 column 3: one plain speckled gray granite garden marker, a broad hand-sized oval face made of coarse stone with a little thickness, visibly matte and grainy, blank with no engraving.
Row 2 column 1: one dark plum canvas fastening strap positioned horizontally. Exactly one large round silver metal press snap at the right middle of the strip, clearly separated from the plum cloth and its visible edge stitches. Wide enough that a later ring can encircle the silver fastener. No text, circle annotation, arrows, or hand.
Row 2 column 2: one small all-silver fluted metal bottle cap seen as an unobstructed three-quarter overhead disk, one prominent soft bright oval reflection in the upper-left part of the face, muted gray crimped edge, no bottle, no color print. This will be the identifiable example cap across three options.
Row 2 column 3: one long horizontal rectangular honey-wood straightedge, 6:1 proportions, all ends visible, strongly visible wood grain, gently rounded corners. Completely unmarked, no numbers or ruler ticks.
Row 3 column 1: one long horizontal rectangular turquoise plastic straightedge with exactly the same dimensions and geometry as the wooden straightedge in row 2 column 3. Clearly uniform molded plastic with a simple glossy rim and subtle molded seam. Unmarked, no numbers or ticks.
Row 3 column 2: one honey-colored wooden craft cog, visible flowing grain, gently rounded teeth, central circular hole (transparent alpha in the hole), no screw or metal component.
Row 3 column 3: exactly two discrete small objects side by side without touching, a shiny all-metal office paper clip on the left and a molded turquoise plastic fork on the right. They stay jointly within this cell and have separate recognizable silhouettes. No additional objects.
